data_fields.name: bounty_default_posted_price
data_fields.donor_constant: minHitPrice (200) when the hitman has not posted a price

data_fields.name: concurrent_hits_per_hitman
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 (hitman has no hit to take another)

best_idea: A bounty is one contract record per hitman with a 20-second accept window, a posted price inside a fixed band, and per-target and per-customer cooldowns, which the server can settle through an escrow account and pay out only on the named kill.
decision_why: The one-contract record with the two cooldowns and the price band is a clean, checkable bounty shape for PvP-flagged players; reject the donor's pay-at-accept with no refund on abort, and re-run the gates at accept.
acceptance: A server test: a customer orders a 1000-unit bounty on target T; the 1000 moves into escrow on accept; if a third player kills T, the customer's balance returns to its pre-order value and the hitman's is unchanged; if the hitman kills T, the hitman gains 1000, and a new bounty on T is refused for 120 s; a second order from the same customer within 240 s is refused.
